title: Marketing management flashcards: for the Professional Certified Marketer® (PCM®) marketing management exam
releaseBlockers: exam domains and weights not verified (AMA book of knowledge unread)
description: Marketing management: every idea explained before it is tested, every card quoting the source words it rests on.
sourceShort: Wikipedia articles and US Federal Trade Commission guidance
notice: Professional Certified Marketer® and PCM® are marks of the American Marketing Association. This deck is independent and is not affiliated with, sponsored, endorsed or approved by the American Marketing Association. Cards are drafted with AI assistance only from the public sources cited on each card, chiefly Wikipedia articles and US Federal Trade Commission guidance, and every card is checked against its source and reviewed by a person.

checks.what: An independent audit read all 572 cards against the cached Wikipedia articles and FTC pages, and checked every scenario's explanation letters against its choices
checks.result: 2 wrong answers, 9 ambiguous, 24 unsupported and 7 unclear cards were fixed; cards resting on text marked "citation needed" or on an article flagged for possibly machine-generated text were rewritten, and the 16 market segmentation cards now cite the article as it stood on 13 November 2022.
